title: Health Resort east wing room 308 key

infobox.usage: Unlocks room 308 of the East wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort east wing room 308 key (E308 San) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium east wing room 308.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Connected to room 306 through the balcony.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Woods
sections.text: - In cabin no. 1 in the lumber camp on top of a nightstand. The nightstand is between two beds that are end-to-end. The cabin is the closest one to the Yotota truck.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The third floor, room 308 of the East Wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Room 306:
  - 1× LEDX Skin Transilluminator spawn
  - 1× DVL-10 spawn
  - 1× Flyye MBSS backpack (UCP) spawn
  - 4× PC blocks
  - 1× Weapon box (4x4)
  - Rare spawn
  - Loose loot (Currency)
- Room 308:
  - 1× Weapon Rack
  - 1× Weapon spawn
  - 1× Medcase
  - Loose loot (Currency)
